text_block_list.text:
Найс Нэйчер's signature racewear has
arrived, so I
have her try it on
immediately to see how it looks.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I like how it's not too flashy, yet not too

bland—just like me. I think it's nice.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
choice_data_list: It's a little low-key, but I like it.

text_block_list.text:
Right? I didn't want the design to be too
gaudy
and end up with my clothes
wearing me.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
All the elements I wanted in the design
are
included. I think it looks about right.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Speaking of design choices, I take
another look
at her signature racewear.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It's a striking ensemble—red and green
from ear
covers to sleeves, with
matching bows.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: Really reminds me of the holidays.

text_block_list.text:
Doesn't it? It's a little out of character
for me, but
the holidays actually mean a
lot to me.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: My mom raised me all by herself.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
She worked all the time to support me
with
almost no rest... day in and day out.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I didn't want to cause her any more
trouble, so I
tried not to be too
demanding.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
But during that special time of year, I
could be a
child.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I wholeheartedly believed that Santa
existed, so I
always made sure to send
him a letter with my list.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Stuff like, "I wanna have a big party with
my mom!
And make it flashy!"
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
After I asked for that, my mom and the
regulars
at the bar started having a
holiday party for me
every year.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
We had chicken skewers instead of roast
chicken,
bar snacks instead of a cake, a
disco ball for the
lights...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: I know it's far from what others consider normal, but it felt big and flashy to me.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Heh, looking back, I was such a pure
child, not
knowing who the real Santa
was!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
They put together a holiday party the
year I was
accepted into Tracen
Academy too...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
It's that time of year again! And look
who's here,
Natie! Santa!
text_block_list.name: Bar Regular A

text_block_list.text: Hey, stop that! I'm not a kid anymore!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
So? You're never too old for Santa.
Remember
when you told us we were all
Santa for throwing
these parties for you?
That really made our day.
text_block_list.name: Bar Regular B

text_block_list.text:
Hnnngh... Sorry... I was such a little child
back
then.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Don't apologize! Now it's your turn to make our wishes come true!
text_block_list.name: Bar Regular B

text_block_list.text:
That's right! This year, we're asking
Santa to let us
see you blazing down the
track!
text_block_list.name: Bar Regular C

text_block_list.text:
Go for the gold! Let's celebrate again
when you
get first place!
text_block_list.name: Bar Regular A

text_block_list.text:
They really cheered for me, but look at
me now...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I ask if she was thinking of their wish
when she
chose this signature racewear.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Haha... You know me so well...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
choice_data_list: Sounds like we've got some work to do!
It's the perfect racewear for you!

text_block_list.text: Haha... You know me so well...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
choice_data_list: Sounds like we've got some work to do!
It's the perfect racewear for you!

text_block_list.text:
Her mother and the regulars back
home... Not to
mention the people from
the shopping district
who she got to
know here...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
They're all wishing for her victory. Which
means
our goal is...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list:
Let's become their Santa and make their wishes
come true!

text_block_list.text: A-again with the Santa thing...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I don't know... Sounds like a lot of
pressure. This
egg just might crack.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Well, aren't you just the picture of
confidence?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
If I'm Santa, then that would make you...
a
reindeer? Haha, we should get you a
red nose.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: ...Right. I don't know what to say, but...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I'm glad you have such high hopes for
me. Haha.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Her tone is sarcastic, but she seems
happy.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: What do you mean by that?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
choice_data_list: We're making your next race a real flashy affair!

text_block_list.text:
Flashy, huh? I wonder if I can pull that
off.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I guess I'll try. I owe everyone, including
you, at
least that much.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
It won't be too long until she makes
everyone's
wishes come true. Seeing
Найс Нэйчер in her
signature racewear
makes me sure of it.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
If possible, I'd like to avoid wearing a
red nose,
but I feel like it'd be okay as
long as it makes
Найс Нэйчер happy.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
